The Brady girls try to play matchmaker between Carol's free-spirited grandmother and stick-in-the-mud Grandpa Brady.

Cindy studies hard and passes a test to appear on a TV quiz show, but an overconfident Bobby does not. But after she passes, he ego goes out of control. Meanwhile, Mike and Carol make plans for a dinner party.
Ann has to go to court to help a producer win a lawsuit involving a shish-kebab skewer.
Ann sees her neighbor Ruthie kissing another man.
After Donald injures his back in her apartment, Ann brings his interviewer to Don.
Don wants to take Ann to the theater on her birthday. However, Ann promised to babysit a sick child.
Donald finally asks Ann Marie to marry him and takes his buddies' advice to buy the ring second-hand.
Donald has Ann investigate his sister's new beau.
Oscar discovers he's in poor physical condition and reluctantly goes along with Felix's suggestion that he build himself up.

After Felix induces Oscar to appear on the popular talk show Steinberg is guest-hosting, his roommate gives a riotous account of Felix's prissiness. Felix is incensed, and when Steinberg invites him to make a rebuttal, he leaps at the opportunity.
Hoping to get closer to his son, Felix becomes coach of the boy's football team.
Blanche tells Oscar she is remarrying and invites him and Felix to the wedding.
After their apartment is robbed, Felix talks Oscar into moving in. The new dwelling is a super-security building supervised by an over-zealous manager.
Bobby becomes obsessed with Jesse James. Mike and Carol don't approve of his new hero, and try to find a way to convince him that James was nothing but a "mean, dirty killer."
Marcia breaks a date with Charlie when "big man on campus" Doug Simpson asks her out. However, after she gets hit in the nose with a football, Doug Simpson breaks his date with her.

Peter gets a job at the bike shop, but he is fired after three days. He doesn't want to tell his parents the bad news, because he told the family he might be getting a promotion to salesman the day he got fired.
